title: Design basis
prerequisites: Current transport/survey procedures; site survey walkdown; material and floor samples/records.
procedure: Walk each use case with site RP and operators. Record material, surface, purpose, averaging area, patch dimensions, release authority, background range, direct/wipe steps and mission time.
expected_result_and_evidence: Signed design-input sheet with interval, gap and background envelope, numerical confidence and productivity budgets or explicitly restricted use cases. Yellowcake criterion stays disabled until approved.

title: Handling and service
prerequisites: Ready-to-lift ballasted unit, calibrated scale, candidate dock or transfer fixture, handling assessment approved.
procedure: Weigh and locate balance point. Perform glove-on lift, placement, swap and recovery on representative load heights. Inspect mounts and grips after the agreed proof load.
expected_result_and_evidence: Recorded mass and moment within agreed site bounds. Operator demonstrates approved one-person transfer without uncontrolled tilt or window contact; otherwise record required lifting aid and revised method.

title: Drive and braking
prerequisites: Guarded floor fixture, agreed slopes and surfaces, maximum permitted mass, independent position and stop-distance instrumentation.
procedure: Run both directions and turn under representative traction/load. Inject timeout, power loss and wheel slip. Measure latency, deceleration, coast and powered-off holding.
expected_result_and_evidence: Every authorized motion stops inside measured protective margin at its declared speed. Rollback, slip and thermal/current limits within approved envelopes; restrict failing modes.

title: Edge and look-ahead
prerequisites: Floor-level drop simulator with physical catch, actual wheel/skid envelope, motion/edge traces.
procedure: Approach normal and oblique, reverse and pivot. Expose each sensor to dark, wet, shiny and missing returns. Inject stale and stuck sensors. Verify look-ahead slowing and near-edge stop separately.
expected_result_and_evidence: In every permitted direction all support points stay within the protected surface including worst delay and uncertainty margin. Invalid sensor inhibits affected motion. Independent physical protection is in place for elevated trials.

title: Bumper and independent stop
prerequisites: Guarded fixture, stopwatch or acquisition trace, circuit diagram, sacrificial obstacles and protected drivetrain.
procedure: Activate head tips, front, sides and rear contact zones; actuate local/external stops; disconnect bumper/head circuit; freeze ROS/host and test reset/restart.
expected_result_and_evidence: Recorded stop latency meets verified brake budget; no uncommanded restart or movement on unplug. Reset requires a deliberate operator command after clearing the fault.

title: Closed-door supervision and unattended protective holds
prerequisites: Unoccupied secured trailer or equivalent mock, operator station, independent stopping channel and approved access/recovery plan.
procedure: At the far end of a secured, unoccupied mock trailer compare supervised commissioning with qualified unattended mode. Disconnect a viewer and Wi-Fi separately from each required protective link; open protected access and simulate immobilization. Restore signals and retrieve under the site procedure.
expected_result_and_evidence: Commissioning holds on loss of its required operator link. Qualified unattended tests preserve acquisition on viewer loss. Breaking a protective link or losing secured access causes a local hold within the validated budget in either mode. Link recovery cannot command restart. Save event, alert-delivery and recovery records.

title: Localization and map alignment
prerequisites: Measured floor fiducials, surveyed head transform, representative repetitive walls, floor features and wheel loads.
procedure: Compare robot poses and transformed head footprints with independent floor references over straight, reversing and turning paths. Induce slide, loss of view and similar wall returns.
expected_result_and_evidence: Measured error and time uncertainty are within approved map/coverage budgets through accepted segments. Localization faults generate exclusions and a controlled hold or relocalization event.

title: Coverage and sweep geometry
prerequisites: Ground-truth floor rectangle, wheel/trailer limits, active aperture polygons and small target markers, threshold physical guard.
procedure: Plan traversals over all accessible floor. Inspect boundaries, joints, corners, interruptions and offset passes; block one strip and remove one lane. Compare map of swept active polygons to independent reference.
expected_result_and_evidence: No unobserved strip labelled surveyed. All approved accessible areas meet valid exposure or are explicitly reported unresolved. Report inaccessible wall, door and obstruction areas separately with locations.

title: Head swap and interchange
prerequisites: Dummy and sensor cassette or dimensionally equivalent optical mock, power isolation, interfaces and gauge fixture.
procedure: Repeatedly remove/reinstall with gloves, identify serials and lane geometry, measure transform, retention and window clearance. Exercise wrong key, missing latch/head and power isolation.
expected_result_and_evidence: Mechanically positive and keyed engagement, repeatability inside approved transform/standoff budget, head replacement records a calibration change; unplugged or unlatched configuration inhibits survey drive.

title: SiPM front end and ADC
prerequisites: Bench pulse generator and oscilloscope, calibrated charge injection or reference pulser, representative EVT optics and allowed sources.
procedure: Record analog waveforms across temperature and count rate. Check polarity, baseline, noise, classification/crosstalk, gain, dead time, counter rollover, ADC clipping and recovery.
expected_result_and_evidence: Time-correlated raw capture verifies thresholds and live time. Saturation, gain excursions or lost intervals are flagged; leakage and usable range are measured per channel before qualification.

title: Head power and EMC
prerequisites: Selected head and harness, oscilloscope, power analyzer, steady reference field or electrical test pulsers, independent protection.
procedure: Exercise startup, heater PWM, drive acceleration, safe current-limited stall, low supply and branch fault. Observe voltage, noise, resets and classified count rates.
expected_result_and_evidence: No unsafe interaction between power and bumper/stop. Valid frames stay inside agreed supply/gain/noise margins; otherwise acquisition inhibits and explicitly flags affected data. Record peak and average at pack and head.

title: Runtime and reserve
prerequisites: Selected pack/BMS, verified brakes, mission route with expected holds, current logger and measured ambient temperatures.
procedure: Operate the longest approved mission with heaters and rescans at cold boundary. Include start/stop peaks and recovery reserve. Test low battery hold and regeneration/charge interlocks.
expected_result_and_evidence: Complete mission plus documented reserve or record a shorter qualified duration. No undervoltage reset or charge outside selected pack limits, and controlled hold preserves data.

title: Warm-start winter qualification
prerequisites: Environmental chamber or controlled equivalent, known initial component temperatures/state of charge, sensor and housing thermal instrumentation.
procedure: Warm-start at −20 °C ambient, include outdoor pre-survey wait, full duty, stationary dwell and return to warmth. Separately test −25 °C stretch before claiming. Inspect fog, frost, leakage and cables.
expected_result_and_evidence: At claimed mission duration all components stay within qualified bounds. Verify optical response, traction/braking, communication and valid time. Record failures and resulting operational limits; untested stretch has no field claim.

title: Heater and temperature faults
prerequisites: Separate chassis/head heater circuits, thermal spreader, calibrated temperature logger, protected fault-injection rig.
procedure: Apply open/short sensor, stuck heater demand, hot spot and power loss. Measure protection operation; switch heater in and out during digitization.
expected_result_and_evidence: Independent zone control and independent protective cutout/interlock act as designed. Affected data are invalidated; select insulation/setpoints only after measured temperature and count stability.

title: Optics, standoff and charged-particle leakage
prerequisites: One full-size stack, controlled height/raster fixture, production window and grille candidates, authorized alpha/beta standards and photon-reference arrangements.
procedure: Measure front/reference response near SiPM, far corners and boundaries across the proposed gap range. Vary absorber composition/areal density. Measure crosstalk and graded source depths/energies.
expected_result_and_evidence: Measured active response area, gap dependence, threshold efficiency, lane isolation and target leakage meet the approved sensitivity allocation or a redesign is documented before ordering four stacks.

title: Calibration and applicability
prerequisites: Traceable planar sources, authorized material profile, blank substrate, production film/grille, environmental logging and stable electronics.
procedure: Determine per-head, per-lane and stream response to activity density at qualified working distance; evaluate source certificate basis, backscatter and self-absorption. Compare with an independent instrument under compatible geometry.
expected_result_and_evidence: Calibration package records radionuclide or mixture basis, K, uncertainty/covariance, configuration, geometry and validity range. Unsupported profiles reject evaluation.

title: Compensation in photon fields
prerequisites: Independent development and held-out sessions with representative spectra/intensities/directions and spatial gradients, clean substrates and traceable comparison targets.
procedure: Fit class/lane coefficients on clean data. Compare gross and corrected results on held-out blank and seeded runs; vary angle, overlap, dose rate, temperature, local gradients and absorber.
expected_result_and_evidence: Within signed operating envelope residual bias, prediction uncertainty and false alarms meet profile budgets. Demonstrate compensated target response and coverage; reject extrapolation. Retain raw intervals and both layers.

title: Scan performance and patch challenge
prerequisites: Frozen configuration, stated patch size, dwell, standoff, speed, background envelope, decision rule and independent blind ground truth.
procedure: Randomize blank and seeded traversals with patches in lane centre, seam, ends and relative time-bin offsets. Test across backgrounds and floor types. Reserve independent trials for confirmation.
expected_result_and_evidence: For the ore design case demonstrate moving detection limit below 0.20 Bq/cm² on defined patches, and agreed detection probability and false investigations at 0.30 Bq/cm² with confidence intervals. Record excluded conditions or reduce speed when unmet.

title: Acquisition integrity and timing
prerequisites: Head/emulator, host logger, common timed stimulus, independent clock trace, decodable raw records.
procedure: Replay normal, wrap/reset, CRC damage, duplicate, stale, missing, over-range and invalid live time. Scope common stimulus alongside moving pose clock. Repeat across dropped link and reboot.
expected_result_and_evidence: No lost/duplicated events silently accepted. Valid zero retains live time. Corrupt or unsynchronized data and affected swept intervals are identified; reported timing error at max speed meets approved position budget.

title: Mapping, uncertainty and replay
prerequisites: Known trajectory with independent aperture truth, spatially varying signal, calibration versions, blank and injected faults.
procedure: Replay twice; compare to analytic or independently integrated cases including seam, repeated observations, rotations, parked count and signed negative estimates. Drop pose and reference streams.
expected_result_and_evidence: Same raw data/configuration reproduce same counts, qualified exposure and results at declared tolerance. Unit/geometry tests pass, no synthetic counts from invalid data, reported variance agreement documented.

title: Survey profiles and permissions
prerequisites: Approved ore profile and deliberately missing/mismatched, unapproved or wrong-unit profiles, read-only/operator and RP roles.
procedure: Load, edit, authorize and version profiles, select material and purpose, convert explicit units, attempt wrong calibration and attempt to change threshold mid-run.
expected_result_and_evidence: Unauthorized or incomplete settings cannot produce a decision. Configuration revision, user/role, method and units appear in report; no implied yellowcake preset. Historical runs retain applied revisions.

title: Recount and decision logic
prerequisites: Traceable sequences around investigation/criterion, poor-statistics and bad-pose intervals, background shifts and stop-capable motion mock.
procedure: Replay borderline and out-of-range cases; request stationary count, requalification or site follow-up. Exercise maximum recount duration and conflicting repeated outcomes.
expected_result_and_evidence: Approved decision logic distinguishes threshold crossing, insufficient sensitivity and unresolved results. Hold/recount becomes an explicit event with location and traceable disposition; a marginal estimate alone cannot clear a patch.

title: Cleanability, ingress and service
prerequisites: Representative wheel/caster, printed finish, materials and cleaning agents approved by site; removable covers and surrogate tracer.
procedure: Expose representative textured floors, cracks and service joints to safe tracer; clean including wheels/caster, inspect window seals and handholds, repeat detector response after service.
expected_result_and_evidence: Demonstrate site-approved check/clean workflow and residual criteria. Identify inaccessible reservoirs and disposition. Document film replacement and calibration checks; no implied IP rating.

title: Closed-loop pilot and report signing
prerequisites: Passed G1–G3 with deviations approved, mode-specific protections and procedures, reference survey team and stored calibration records. Commission occupied pilot routes only after the corresponding surrogate and stop trials have passed.
procedure: Operators complete setup, survey and review. Independently survey selected blanks, hotspots and inaccessible strips. Compare results, coverage, mission time, holds and raw-data archive.
expected_result_and_evidence: Site RP signs pilot comparison and approved use envelope. Report identifies floor-only scope, exclusions, open follow-ups, owners and release authority. Demonstration does not constitute general operational release.

title: ROS and platform independence
prerequisites: Pinned supported ROS build, modular drivers, dummy head and real or emulated sensing payload, run log.
procedure: Exercise mission without live radiometric source using simulator/replay. Disconnect or swap head after isolation. Simulate ROS process exit, drive watchdog and independent safety stop.
expected_result_and_evidence: Rebuild/run reproducibly within documented environment; replacement head uses the same acquisition contract; software failure cannot bypass local protective stop or turn invalid data into valid survey.

title: Mission checkpoint and archive
prerequisites: Run logger, representative storage headroom and interrupted mission fixture.
procedure: Kill acquisition and navigation processes, disconnect power on a safe fixture, restart and inspect run/session IDs, sequence gaps and profile references; test export and replay offline.
expected_result_and_evidence: Committed data persist with completeness/quality markers. New epochs cannot bridge unknown travel; missed ranges remain unresolved until qualified coverage is repeated. Verify restoration from archive.

title: Guided hotspot sequence and parking
prerequisites: Ground-level secured mock trailer, three blinded targets in different lanes, return park and an unreachable target. Define positional accuracy from minimum patch and mapping uncertainty.
procedure: Start a tour, hold at each target, attempt idle timeout, duplicate Next and second-client Next; Skip/Defer one target, block an approach, lose localization, then Park after the last reachable visit. Repeat after reconnect and restart.
expected_result_and_evidence: Independent surveyed markers confirm correct lane, heading and position to tolerance. No unsolicited movement. Stale requests do not advance the queue. Unreachable targets stay listed; final parking is acknowledged only after verified arrival. Archive original coordinates and full audit trail.

title: Shared browser controls and local indications
prerequisites: Robot-hosted UI on supported phone and laptop, two logins, observer and controller roles, glove-ready controls, local stops and representative lighting.
procedure: Join both browsers, hand off authority, close one tab, suspend a phone and replay an old Next. Exercise local start/pause/stop/E-stop; compare physical indicator patterns and screen state without relying on color.
expected_result_and_evidence: One current operator can issue movement requests. All clients see state and command outcome after reconnect. Observers cannot move the robot. Conflicting commands, reset and ordinary viewer closure cause no uncommanded restart; physically indicated stop state agrees with the motion controller.

title: Unattended qualification and guided close-work inhibit
prerequisites: Passed guarded mock fault injection and pilot access controls, named responder and agreed intrusion, detection, timing and alert thresholds.
procedure: Authorize the secured unattended survey and leave the console. Lose observer Wi-Fi, then separately trip access protection, a required protective heartbeat, low reserve, detector or storage fault. Test the alert route. At a shared-space follow-up stop, inhibit drive for close work, attempt Next while inhibited, clear the local envelope, deliberately rearm, then request travel with the attendant still in the trailer.
expected_result_and_evidence: The unattended scan continues without a live viewer while required protections are healthy. Protective faults produce the local response and are archived, including gaps when alerts are undeliverable. Close-work inhibit blocks movement and queued commands. Field clearance or reconnect cannot restart a mission. Verify the named response and recovery plan.

title: Gloved swap and charge/service isolation
prerequisites: Selected cell pack/BMS, approved charger with power-path design, safe current-limited source, simulator for cold temperature, representative grips and recovery log.
procedure: Swap after save and controlled power isolation. Test latch, polarity keying, inrush, pack-present and outlet guards. With charger connected exercise power-on and restricted configuration/export; attempt all motion paths including local input and remote commands. Simulate cold-charge inhibit, charger loss and reboot.
expected_result_and_evidence: Record swap time and retained data IDs. Cold cells receive no forbidden charge. Concurrent loads remain within supply/thermal ratings and charger termination remains correct. Traction stays disabled while connected; unplugging or restoring mains never launches the program.

title: Tethered detector service and calibration
prerequisites: Selected patch length, secured isolated base, detached head on metrology fixture, local hardwired traction inhibit, controlled electrical load and authorized reference/check sources.
procedure: Compare mounted and extended harness supplies, error rates, clock quality, heater interference and counts. Perform a prescribed source-response bump check, an efficiency measurement at the intended 10 mm nominal geometry and a separate contact-bumper function test. Simulate missing cable/interlock, partial insertion or attempted mission.
expected_result_and_evidence: No traction under bench/service setup; loss of power/data/interlock enters designed safe condition. Voltage and noise margins and count agreement meet specified budgets. Record source and fixture IDs, actual standoff, channel live time and separate check/calibration results; bench data never receives field coverage credit.

title: Loaded cantilever and rail challenge
prerequisites: Ballast spanning anticipated module mass/moment, secured ground-level mock, independent displacement/acceleration instrumentation, load cells, sacrificial protected window, representative roughness and safe debris surrogates.
procedure: Measure head and wheel reactions under static load and run bumps, diagonal seam, sharp splinter surrogate, compact/soft deposits, start/stop, turns and braking. Compare 3 and 5 mm rail drops at 10 mm nominal film gap. Sample corner and central protection, pitch and bounce; repeat at cold operating envelope.
expected_result_and_evidence: Measured maximum deflection and vibration stay within qualified radiometric gap with positive stability margin and bumper stopping allowance. No target window strike during qualified tests. Document missed fine objects, rail nuisance rate, signal attenuation and suspension/clearance or operating restrictions. Include response map and tolerances.

title: Connection handshake, descriptor and count-stream identity
prerequisites: Two distinct representative head identities or emulators, independent surveyed geometry, valid and expired/mismatched calibration records and a commissioning-only dummy mode.
procedure: Capture the first handshake and a consecutive series of count replies. Test unknown head, unsupported revisions, malformed or out-of-envelope lanes, corrupt descriptor and serial/calibration mismatch. Disconnect and reconnect the same and a different head. Power-cycle the MCU while attached and interrupt the host. Challenge stale buffered data and verify host-only conversion with known counts.
expected_result_and_evidence: Approved identity, descriptor and geometry are read at the handshake. Ordinary count frames omit identity, geometry and configuration IDs. The host archives one unambiguous connection association with its raw counts. Detachment, reset or uncertain continuity invalidates the old binding. No new survey data are credited until a fresh handshake, time alignment and arming. Unknown configurations inhibit acquisition for survey. Host replay with the approved calibration reproduces the result.

title: Field relocation by active lane and offset
prerequisites: Mock hazards and surveyed marks in a representative floor, independent location reference, approved approach/inhibit and target accuracy protocol.
procedure: Place blinded patches near seams and walls. With the technician remaining in the qualified shared space, guide the robot to a parked-over target and then to a registered offset for a hand measurement. Engage close-work inhibit where the technician must reach into the motion envelope. Include an unreachable target near a protected edge or wall. Compare the marked locations with surveyed truth.
expected_result_and_evidence: For reachable spots independently measured error satisfies the agreed field tolerance. Store coordinates, uncertainty and reason for unreachable locations. The robot stays drive-inhibited during close work. Once the local envelope is clear it waits for deliberate rearm and an explicit movement command. Archive each visit against its original flag.

title: Occupied-area detection and measured stopping margin
prerequisites: Ground-level representative aisle, instrumented lower-limb targets and corner/pinch fixtures, defined approach speeds, allowed masses and floor/temperature limits. Document the required safety function, margin and acceptance basis before testing.
procedure: Exercise forward, reverse, turns, lateral approach, wide-head overhang, hidden feet and corner/wall pinch points. Challenge sensing faults, occlusion, frost, distraction and worst reaction/braking on approved surfaces. Use targets for hazardous challenges. Then demonstrate a witnessed scan, Next, Expose and Park with a technician remaining in the cleared part of the same trailer. Block a pass and restore access without automatic motion.
expected_result_and_evidence: Record actual detection, controller/actuator latency, stopping travel and smallest separation against the declared margin for each direction. Detection or an unsafe fault produces a local protective stop. Close work requires verified drive inhibit and deliberate rearm. Healthy shared-space travel can proceed with workers inside. Failed directions or routes are restricted, blocked floor areas stay unresolved, and no elevated-door control is bypassed.
